newsitem.title: USA: Rain likely in dry HRW wheat areas this week - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Rain likely in dry HRW wheat areas this week - WSC.

text.p: Two storm systems were forecast for the central Plains this week, with the second one expected late this week offering the best chance for rain in dry wheat areas of northern Kansas, said Joel Burgio, Weather Services Corp meteorologist.
Storms late Tuesday and Wednesday may produce 0.25 to 1.0 inch of rain across eastern Nebraska and northeast Kansas, but lesser amounts in western and central Kansas, he said.
A second system due in the central Plains late this week could dampen dry northern Kansas areas with 0.1 to 1.0 inch of rain.
"It does look like it will get a least a few thundershowers," Burgio said of northern Kansas.
Light, scattered showers were likely across Oklahoma and Texas wheat areas, he said.
In Kansas, 25 to 40 mph winds are likely this week, which could create clouds of dust in areas missed by the rain, Burgio said.
